data.name: Mashta
data.gender_notes: Mashta is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is graceful and beautiful in her actions and appearance. The name Mashta carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mashta usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Representing the divine feminine, Mashta embodies grace, beauty, and the power of nature
data.etymology: Mashta belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mashta total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: مشتى
in_arabic.meaning: مشتى، اسم مجرور، يعني الرجل الغني، أو من أهل الثروة
in_arabic.long_meaning: مشتى، اسم مجرور، يعني الرجل الغني، أو من أهل الثروة، يعود هذا الاسم إلى الجذر (ش-ط-ي) في العربية، والذي يعني الثروة أو الغنى، ويُستخدم في القرآن الكريم في سورة يوسف 12: 36-41، وفي الحديث النبوي الشريف، ويعتبر اسمًا مشتقًا من الأصل الأصلي، ولكنه يحتوي على معنى غني وغني المال، ويُعادل في بعض الأحيان اسم (مشتى) مع اسم (مشتى البعير) في التسمية الشعبية

in_urdu.name: مشتى
in_urdu.meaning: مشتى، غنی شخص، جسے ثروت ہو، یا وہ شخص جو مالدار ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مشتى، غنی شخص، جسے ثروت ہو، یا وہ شخص جو مالدار ہے، اس نام کے پس منظر میں عرب کے جڑے (ش-ط-ی) ہیں، جو ثروت یا دولت کے معنی کے لیے استعمال ہوتے ہیں، قرآن میں یوسف کے 12: 36-41، اور حدیث میں، یہ ایک مصدر کا نام ہے، اور اسے غنی اور دولت والا گویا بنایا گیا ہے، یہ نام کبھی کبھی مشتہ البعیر کے نام کے ساتھ استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मश्टा
in_hindi.meaning: मश्टा, धनी व्यक्ति, जिसके पास धन है, या वे व्यक्ति जो धनी है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मश्टा, धनी व्यक्ति, जिसके पास धन है, या वे व्यक्ति जो धनी है, इस नाम के पीछे अरबी जड़ (श-ट-य) हैं, जो धन या समृद्धि के अर्थ में आते हैं, क़ुरआन में यूसुफ के 12: 36-41, और हदीस में, यह एक मूल नाम है, और इसे धनी और धनवान बनाया गया है, इसे कभी-कभी मश्ता बेिर के नाम के साथ उपयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: مشتى
in_pashto.meaning: مشتى، په غني ښځه، چې په ثروت لرو، یا یواځې ښځه، چې په مالدارۍ لرو
in_pashto.long_meaning: مشتى، په غني ښځه، چې په ثروت لرو، یا یواځې ښځه، چې په مالدارۍ لرو، په دې نوم کې عربي ځانګړي (ش-ط-ی) شتون لري، چې ثروت کېښودلې ده، په قرآن کې یوسف کې 12: 36-41، او په حديث كې، دا یو مبدا نوم دی، او دا دا نوم لري چې دا د ثروت او دا غني وو، دا دې نوم ته په کې ځانګړی نوم مشتې بېير هم ورته جوړوي

in_english.name: Mashta
in_english.meaning: Mashta, rich person, one who has wealth, or a person who is wealthy
in_english.long_meaning: Mashta, rich person, one who has wealth, or a person who is wealthy, the name Mashta is derived from the Arabic root (ş-t-â) which means wealth or prosperity, it is mentioned in the Quran in the story of Joseph in chapter 12: 36-41, and in hadiths, it is a noun that means rich and wealthy, it is also used to refer to a person who is blessed with wealth and prosperity

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل

data.cultural_impact: The name Mashta is derived from the Arabic language, which is native to the Muslim world. In Muslim societies, beauty is often highly valued, and the name Mashta reflects this cultural appreciation for grace and beauty. Mashta may be given as a name to a girl who is expected to embody these qualities in her outward appearance, her character, and her demeanor.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the concept of a beautiful and graceful character holds deep significance. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Allah is beautiful, and He loves beauty." Mashta reflects the desired qualities of a virtuous and beautiful soul, which is known as the "soul's adornment" in Islamic teachings. The name signifies the importance of striving to cultivate inner beauty and to present oneself in a gracious and honorable manner. Ultimately, Mashta represents the eternal rewards of pleasing Allah through beautiful and pleasing actions, which in turn bring joy and contentment to the individual and those around them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Graceful, Beautiful" symbolizes The one who is graceful and beautiful in her actions and appearance. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mashta serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of graceful, beautiful.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun describes Mashta as a city and important trading post on the Mediterranean coast of Syria, about 20 kilometers south of modern-day Tartus. It was a significant commercial hub during the Mamluk Sultanate (1250-1517).

Al-Idrisi, in his Geography, mentions Mashta as a city located at the northern end of the gulf of Antioch in the Mediterranean Sea. It was part of the Fatimid Caliphate (969-1171), and was a major port city and center for the production of cotton textiles.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Mashta' in Islamic history refers to a religious and historical site located in modern-day Syria. It is known for its significance as a pilgrimage destination for Muslims seeking spiritual enlightenment and healing properties of herbs. In the modern context, Mashta is popularized on various digital platforms such as GoogleMaps for its location and directional assistance, Instagram for its scenic visual appeal, and Wikipedia for its historical and informative content.
